title: Champions carry the business
finding: Champions are 20% of customers but 73% of historical net revenue (£11.93M).
action: Reward and recruit: early access, loyalty perks, referral asks. Avoid discounting - they already buy.

title: High-value customers are going quiet
finding: 1,482 at-risk customers spent £2.77M historically (17% of revenue) but have not bought for a median of 176 days.
action: Win-back now: personalised outreach, 'we miss you' offer, ask for feedback.

title: November is the peak month
finding: November averages 1.8x the typical month, and October-December bring 35% of annual revenue.
action: Build stock and campaign calendars backwards from this peak; launch loyalty perks before September.

title: What predicts a high-value customer
finding: The model relies most on: monetary, total items, avg order value. (Ranked by held-out feature importance.)
action: Use these signals to build a simple early-warning score for the CRM team.

title: Products that sell together
finding: Blue Polkadot Cup and Pink Polkadot Cup appear together in 521 orders (lift 31.8x; 68% of orders with the first also contain the second).
action: Bundle them, or show one on the other's product page and basket.

title: Returns are worth watching
action: Track return rate by product and customer; investigate any item well above the average.

title: Revenue is concentrated in one market
finding: United Kingdom generates 85% of net revenue; the next market, EIRE, only 3.2%.
action: Test export-focused promotions in the 2-3 largest secondary markets before broad expansion.

title: Many customers never come back
finding: 28% of customers have placed exactly one order.
action: Add a second-purchase journey: replenishment reminder and affinity-based recommendation within 30 days.

title: Personalised recommendations beat best-sellers
finding: In a time-aware test the hybrid recommender reached precision@5 0.066 versus 0.029 for a popularity baseline (+130%).
action: Use the hybrid list in post-purchase emails and on the basket page; A/B test against best-sellers.

title: Some revenue cannot be linked to a customer
finding: Guest checkouts without a CustomerID account for 14% of net revenue and are invisible to segmentation and recommendations.
action: Prompt guests to create an account at checkout: it improves segmentation and recommendations.
